tagline: Your photos belong in a book

01-welcome.headline: Your photos belong in a book
01-welcome.sub: Turn favorite moments into a beautifully arranged photo book, right on your device.

03-refine-selection.sub: Review a balanced selection, bring favorites back in, and decide exactly what belongs in your book.

04-smart-layout.headline: A polished first draft in moments
04-smart-layout.sub: PhotoBooks builds balanced pages automatically, so you can begin with a book—not a blank canvas.

05-photo-tools.headline: Make the moments that matter stand out
05-photo-tools.sub: Emphasize, replace, add, or remove photos with focused controls that stay out of your way.

08-cover.headline: Create a cover worth keeping
08-cover.sub: Give your story a memorable opening with a full wraparound cover and editable title.

10-export.headline: From your device to the printed page
10-export.sub: Preview finished pages, then export print-ready files for Blurb or a universal PDF.
